availability.reason: Native exceptions propagate, but this exporter does not implement the evaluator capture envelope or collect traces.

description: Caller-owned observation of a native raised Python exception or cancellation; exporter does not implement capture.
observation_interface: Caller-owned try/except and separate cancellation capture; proposed envelope, not a native Nanobot output.

payload_schema.description: Evaluator-owned observation envelope, not a native Nanobot response. Capture at the SDK call boundary; cancellation needs separate handling from Exception.

production_timing: At the caller's await boundary when an exception/cancellation propagates.
